# Draft:Dewar Mark Ugude

----
Dewar Mark Ugude (also written as Owar Mark Ugude or Uwar Mark Ugude) is a South Sudanese politician and party official serving in the Sudan People’s Liberation Movement (SPLM). He is the Assistant Secretary for Culture, Information and Communication in the SPLM Eastern Equatoria State Secretariat Office.
Political career
SPLM Eastern Equatoria State Secretariat
On 13 August 2025, Ugude was appointed Assistant Secretary for Culture, Information and Communication in the SPLM Eastern Equatoria State Secretariat following an official order issued by the SPLM State Chairman.
He was sworn into office during a ceremony held in Torit, presided over by Louis Lobong Lojore, the Governor of Eastern Equatoria State and Chairperson of the SPLM State Secretariat. The ceremony was attended by senior SPLM officials and party members.
Responsibilities
As Assistant Secretary for Culture, Information and Communication, Ugude is responsible for coordinating party communication, cultural affairs, and public outreach initiatives across Eastern Equatoria State. His role supports the SPLM’s efforts to strengthen grassroots mobilization and improve public engagement, particularly ahead of the anticipated 2026 general elections.
Following his appointment, Ugude pledged to work collaboratively with members of the State Secretariat to promote peace, development, and prosperity in line with the SPLM’s principles.
Political affiliation
Ugude is a member of the Sudan People’s Liberation Movement (SPLM).
